verdict.rationale: Pika lists a first-party "Language Swap: Same voice, new language" app, which covers translating a video while keeping the speaker's voice. The evidence is a single one-line listing, and it never mentions lip sync being carried over. Eleven Multilingual v2 voiceover in 29 languages supports multilingual audio but is not itself video translation. Missing for 10: any evidence of lip-sync preservation, documentation of the Language Swap workflow on finished videos (inputs, supported languages, quality), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
